fixtureOrigin: Synthetic New Recruit import texts and independently source-backed expected attachment actions. Values and labels come from current accepted canonical records, not legacy contracts. Point annotations are ignored export metadata.

corePolicyEvidence.quote: Unless otherwise stated, each bodyguard unit can only have one leader unit and one support unit attached to it.

sourceConstraints: Current non-Legends relations have 3 Leader owners with 9 recipients each, Technoarcheologist Support with 9, Marshal Support with 4 and Datasmith Support with 1.
Datasmith wording says can be attached; it neither requires participation nor grants unlimited or repeated same-role capacity.
ATTACHED UNIT recipient clauses preserve their source sections but do not manufacture reverse participant relations.
Servitor Underseer is a distinct canonical profile from Combat and Gun Servitors. Attachment never rewrites intrinsic profile identity.

Only current AM explicit UNIT-only Upgrade is for Serberys Raiders, which have no canonical Leader or Support recipient relation. No AM Bodyguard Upgrade formed-group example is invented. AH05 general Bodyguard Upgrade behavior needs a separate synthetic product-contract control.
expectationNotes: actions always name recipient first semantically: select Bodyguard recipient, then participant physical instance.
All parsed-unit-N identities refer to export order and remain distinct for duplicate canonical datasheets.
Failed actions must preserve prior membership; successful DETACH removes only the named participant.
equivalentOrders start from a fresh import and must yield the same final normalized group membership.
These are attachment/provenance controls only: no Enhancement, ability or Detachment effects execute in this task.
